CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.customer_360
(
    customer_id INT,
    first_name VARCHAR(100),
    last_name VARCHAR(100),
    email VARCHAR(255),
    gender VARCHAR(50),
    customer_status VARCHAR(50),
    city VARCHAR(100),
    state VARCHAR(100),
    country VARCHAR(100),
    total_orders BIGINT,
    total_items BIGINT,
    total_spend DECIMAL(23,2),
    average_order_value DECIMAL(13,2),
    successful_payments BIGINT,
    total_paid_amount DECIMAL(23,2),
    total_reviews BIGINT,
    average_rating FLOAT
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'synapse_serving/customer_360/',
    DATA_SOURCE = EcommerceGold,
    FILE_FORMAT = ParquetFormat
);



SELECT TOP 10 *
FROM dbo.customer_360;



SELECT
    name,
    location,
    data_source_id,
    file_format_id
FROM sys.external_tables
WHERE name = 'customer_360';

SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_customers
FROM dbo.customer_360;
